## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, what changes, and why.

## Verification

List commands actually executed and their results. Identify checks that failed, were blocked, or were not executed. For hosted changes, include the tested URL and the affected workflows.

## Evidence and privacy

- [ ] Factual changes link to inspectable sources; missing observations remain pending.
- [ ] Synthetic test values are not presented as pilot results or genuine voice evidence.
- [ ] No participant records, contact details, credentials, or private submission answers are included.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and media attribution are updated, or this change does not affect them.
